screenshots.alt: A scene featuring a castle-like structure with two stone towers connected by a bridge. The towers are decorated with torches and banners, and a wooden scaffolding is attached to the left tower. To the right is a small waterfall, and below the bridge, a pathway with lanterns leads through the area where Alex is visible. The background includes trees, rolling hills, and a partly cloudy sky.

A cave scene featuring an underground wooden structure made up of platforms and bridges supported by wooden pillars. The area is dimly lit with torches and lanterns. Cobwebs are scattered throughout, and spiders are visible on the platforms. The cave walls are composed of stone, with occasional patches of dirt and grass.

A landscape showcasing a mountainous terrain with snow-capped peaks in the distance. The scene includes a mix of pine trees and cherry blossom trees with pink foliage. A waterfall flows down one of the mountains, and the foreground features grassy patches and exposed stone surfaces, with a chicken to the right on one of the ledges.

A scene showing three characters standing on a platform made of obsidian and magma blocks near an active Nether portal. One character on the left has light-colored hair and wears dark clothing with purple accents. The middle character, partially inside the glowing purple portal, has dark skin, short black hair, and is dressed in a red shirt with white sleeves and white pants. The character on the right has medium-toned skin, short brown hair, and is wearing a green shirt with blue pants. The background includes a river, green trees, and rolling hills beneath a partly cloudy sky.

A nighttime scene featuring Alex holding a sword, standing in front of a wooden house with a smoking campfire to the right. Alex is surrounded by hostile mobs, including zombies, a creeper, skeletons, and a spider on the roof. Another character is visible inside the house through a window. The sky is dark with stars, emphasizing the nighttime setting.

A scene featuring two characters. On the left, a character is wearing armor and holding a weapon. On the right, another character appears to be in motion, surrounded by swirling white particles. The setting includes a green-tiled floor and orange blocks with intricate patterns in the background.
